_comment: Legal names and parent companies screened by scripts/screening.py against the US Consolidated Screening List and the UFLPA Entity List, on top of the supplier names and aliases the harvester passes in. Keys must match a name in suppliers.json. match_terms are matched whole-word after punctuation is folded to spaces, so 'BYD CO' matches 'BYD Co., Ltd.' but not 'BYD Company'; terms under five characters are ignored. A hit through a parent is reported as via 'parent', so the reviewer sees it is the group, not the plant, that is listed. Only suppliers whose legal or parent names add something to the watchlist name are here; every entry was checked on the date shown.

Huizhou BYD Electronic.legal_name: Huizhou BYD Electronic Co., Ltd. (惠州比亚迪电子有限公司)

parents.name: BYD Precision Manufacture Co., Ltd. (比亚迪精密制造有限公司)

Huizhou BYD Electronic.note: The other direct shareholder, Lead Wealth International Limited (领裕国际有限公司, 65.91%), is not screened by name: the words are generic enough that an unrelated Hong Kong shell of the same name would be reported as BYD.

Smoore.legal_name: Smoore International Holdings Limited (思摩尔国际控股有限公司), HKEX 6969
Smoore.note: The listed company is the holding company; the plants belong to its subsidiary Shenzhen Smoore Technology Limited (深圳麦克韦尔科技有限公司). Both names contain SMOORE, so one term covers both.

EVE Energy.legal_name: EVE Energy Co., Ltd. (惠州亿纬锂能股份有限公司), SZSE 300014
EVE Energy.note: Listed in its own right. The largest shareholder, reported as Xizang Yiwei Holding Co., Ltd. (西藏亿纬控股有限公司), announced a change of name on CNINFO on 2026-09-18; the new name has not been verified, so it is not screened.

Porton.legal_name: Porton Pharma Solutions Ltd. (重庆博腾制药科技股份有限公司), SZSE 300363
Porton.note: Listed in its own right. Named Porton Fine Chemicals Ltd. until January 2018.

CNT.note: The watchlist name CNT is three letters, too short to screen on its own; without this entry the supplier would go unscreened.

IP Sun.legal_name: International Paper & Sun Cartonboard Co., Ltd., Yanzhou, Shandong

parents.name: Shandong Sun Holding Group Co., Ltd.
parents.relationship: owner since buying International Paper's 55% stake (agreed 8 October 2015)

IP Sun.note: Despite the name, International Paper is no longer an owner, so it is deliberately not screened as a parent.

parents.name: Evergreen Hill Enterprise Pte. Ltd.
parents.relationship: owner since buying the business from Mativ Holdings (completed December 2023)

SWM (Mativ).note: Mativ Holdings sold its Engineered Papers business, the cigarette and tobacco papers, to Evergreen Hill Enterprise in 2023. The watchlist's MATV ticker and the harvester's MATIV alias therefore follow a company that no longer owns this supplier.
